purpose: Enables the |u suffix, which converts units that already carry a magnitude.

name: NEWSROOM_US_STATES
purpose: Enables a US state map with category_names us_state.

name: NEWSROOM_VERIFY_MAP_FOOTNOTES
purpose: Verifier also counts numbered-footnote list rows in choropleth maps.

name: NEWSROOM_VERIFY_STRICT_READERS
purpose: Verifier refuses values it used to skip or coerce, such as non-finite numbers.

name: NEWSROOM_VERIFY_STRICT_REFS
purpose: Refuses a claim reference or evidence item that is not a string.

name: NEWSROOM_VISION_VETO_ONLY
purpose: Image-aware critic can only veto; release rests on program evidence.

name: NEWSROOM_VISUAL_BACKENDS
purpose: Comma list of visual backends declared present, skipping their probes.

name: NEWSROOM_VIZ_P95_MS
purpose: P95 latency budget in milliseconds for the viz benchmark; default 10.

name: NEWSROOM_WRITE_TOOLS_ARG_GOLDEN
purpose: Path where the tool-argument golden file is written instead of compared.

name: NEWSROOM_XLS_CONVERT
purpose: Converts downloaded .xls and .ods files to one CSV per sheet.

name: NEWSROOM_XLS_CONVERT_DIR
purpose: Absolute path of the python-calamine bundle used for .xls conversion.

name: NEWSROOM_ZH_ROUTE_DISCLOSURE
purpose: A negated Chinese route statement counts as the abstract-OD disclosure.

name: NEWSROOM_ZH_SOURCE_LINE
purpose: A zh chart names a local file in Chinese.
